docs.title: Literature review
docs.html:
Sleep and stress

Sleep consolidates memory (Smith, 2020). Exam stress rises in the first year (Smith & Lee, 2020), and it lingers (Smith et al., 2020). Smith (2020) found the same in a second sample, and the World Health Organization (2022) agrees (World Health Organization, 2022).

Homework helps little (Lee, 2018). Muller (2007) compared two scripts; see also (Muller, 2007; Bandura, 1977a).

  • Premchand (1936) wrote of it.

  • Bowlby (1969) and (Bowlby, 1969) on attachment.
